final_text:
I submitted run **ADD-03-host-20261005T213335Z-6eeb** (status **partial**), and I read all four crops: b11-full (note 2), b12-full (note 3), b13-left (signatory) and b13-right (stamp). All six provisions have an answer, but the coverage report still lists notes 2 and 3 as unaccounted even though they validate as new register rows. Someone should check why.

- **Note 2 (conflicting):** I proposed a new register row plus an issue. The Arabic measures height from natural ground level *before* grading and filling. The English convenience translation says finished ground level *after* grading. Clause 7.2 says the Arabic governs, so a person needs to decide this.
- **Note 3 (interpretation pending):** a new register row for the duty to notify the Office at least 30 days before any crane is installed. The note doesn't say whether these are calendar days or Working Days.
- **Signatory, stamp and "End of reproduction." (evidence verified):** marked no effect. The stamp is an empty oval with no text.
- **Appendix B opening paragraph (interpretation pending):** marked no effect because it repeats Clause 7.2. The engine refused a precedence annotation on addendum units, so a person must confirm this one.
